results.title: No Paradise If You Are Killed by a Woman
results.overview: A female Kurdish-Norwegian sniper returns to the battlefield she once escaped, driven by vengeance and by the desperate hope of rescuing her younger sister, still imprisoned by ISIS in Mosul.

results.title: Striguni
results.overview: Origolab, an internationally renowned genetical engineering company, establishes a new headquarters within the walls of a small medieval town in Istria and Boris, an ambitous up and coming biologist, gets a position in it. However, he discovers a terrifying secret: whilst Origolab might be on the verge of a scientific breakthrough with discovering eternal life, they have been kidnapping local children to achieve this, putting him before a moral dilemma. Should he try to save the most recent kidnapping victim? Or will he bend under the promise of the scientific discovery of a century?

results.title: Some Reddish Work
results.overview: Set in the 1600s, a group of women are filled with an uncontrollable desire to run, touch, and tear themselves apart

results.title: Of astronauts and ghosts
results.overview: Pedro, the grandfather, Maria, the granddaughter, José, who works as a consignee, and a migrant mother in Spain: these four characters tell us a story that unfolds in the intimate universe of a single place, a labyrinth of relationships and revelations that becomes a surprising metaphor for the country's past and present within a family: a terminally ill grandfather, a youthful love story, the old man who refuses to die, the new man who struggles to come into the world... only one solution is possible...

results.title: Vorágine
results.overview: Vorágine portrays the lives of a group of young dancers over a year and a half in post-pandemic Buenos Aires. Through rehearsals, conversations, breaks in the dressing rooms, and encounters around the city, the film captures the emotional and physical intensity of artistic labor. Set within the everyday rhythm of creation, between passion and exhaustion, between staying and leaving, Vorágine is an intimate document about the essence of youth.

results.title: Siti Vampire
results.overview: Siti is an ordinary girl who accidentally turned into a vampire due to a strange incident. She is trapped at the age of 25 forever, along with all her problems. Siti must find a way to cure herself and return to being a normal human being.

results.title: Pulsatrix
results.overview: Haunted by the early loss of her son, Neta struggles to find peace while working as a housekeeper on a remote farm with her husband, Nelson. When the landowners arrive for the weekend, her buried pain is reawakened and ignites a spiral of revenge, leading to an inevitable confrontation between grief, power, and justice.

results.title: The Girl with the Leica
results.overview: On Bastille Day in 1937, pioneering German-Jewish photojournalist Gerda Taro spends her final day in Paris confronting her past, her complex partnership with Robert Capa, and her absolute commitment to anti-fascist resistance before returning to the front lines of the Spanish Civil War.

results.title: Holiness Kit
results.overview: Sebastián, a young man who has lost his way and sense of purpose in life, meets Carlo Acutis and his Holiness Kit after experiencing a family crisis. Through Carlo's Kit, the teachings of his mother, Antonia Acutis, and the people he meets along the way, Sebastián embarks on a path of transformation and inner conversion, which will lead him to rediscover faith and hope, radically changing his life.

results.title: The Perfect Holiday
results.overview: The group of friends from “Das perfekte Geheimnis” have to ask themselves the question on a chaotic short trip to the south: Is there life after the truth or is their friendship over?

results.title: Свинцовые небеса
results.overview: The plot tells of several civilians captured by the Ukrainian side and locked in an Orthodox church. The Ukrainian Armed Forces plan to use this point as a trap to close the cauldron for the Russian army, and to use the civilians as a human shield. Having learned about this, the heroes develop their own plan, ready to die, but not to allow the implementation of the plans of the Ukrainian nationalists.

results.title: Es frisst
results.overview: After a botched robbery, a young gangster couple takes a mother and her daughter hostage and ends up in a forgotten forest cemetery on the edge of a disused industrial estate.

results.title: Girl Beast
results.overview: Girl Beast is a psychological drama with a magical  and heightened reality, that tells a Lolita story from Lolita's point of view. Sara is a girl beast, an object of desire and a being of desire.  The story is adapted from Cecilie Lind’s novel with the same title. It balances between self-assertion and self-destruction. Loss and liberation. Powerlessness and power.
In an Andean village in Peru, in 1982, Tato, a 12-year-old boy is forced into exile when his family is threatened.

results.title: Hello Cruel World
results.overview: Giovanna, a twelve-year-old born and raised in a small village near Grosseto, possesses an extraordinary imagination and cannot come to terms with the mysterious disappearance of her best friend, Mirko—who has left her all alone to face the bullies at school. Determined to uncover the truth, the courageous girl sets off on an adventure all by herself.

results.title: GunBlade & Me
results.overview: An obsessed, washed-up Sydney filmmaker sets out to uncover what led to the cancellation of his viral high school web series, GunBlade Adventures.

results.title: Echo Chamber
results.overview: An exploration in narcissistic desire, a kind of autoeroticopsis in being the subject of desire for yourself.

results.title: Pirunduk
results.overview: A wronged wife in a remote village on the Tanah Banjar river, South Kalimantan. When she becomes a wandering spirit, she seeks revenge on those who have hurt her and collects debts that have not been paid off during her lifetime.
